subject: Need to shift demo to CTO re-entry window — proposed times
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@novaforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Need to shift demo to CTO re-entry window — proposed times

Hi Alicia,

Quick heads up — Tom mentioned he can join the technical walkthrough but is returning from travel on Tue, Apr 13 and will be pretty jet‑lagged that morning. To make sure the CTO can attend for the key architecture + SLA discussion, can we move the demo we had penciled for Apr 12?

Proposed options that work on our side (all PT):
- Wed Apr 14, 10:00–10:45 (45 min) — ideal; gives Tom a half day after travel
- Thu Apr 15, 16:00–16:45 (45 min) — fallback if morning is tight

I attached an updated MAP (Proposed-MAP-v2.pdf) and a short roles list so Tom can see who will speak to infra and security. If neither works, tell us Tom's first reasonable window after travel and we'll try to accommodate.

If we move the time, Marissa will update the invite and tighten the agenda to 45 minutes to respect exec bandwidth.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0183

Attachments: Proposed-MAP-v2.pdf (doc), Novaforge-Roles-List.csv (csv)

From: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@novaforge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novaforge.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to shift demo to CTO re-entry window — proposed times

Thanks Steph — appreciate the note.

Tom just confirmed with me that he lands midday on Apr 13 and needs the remainder of the day to settle. He asked if we could aim for Wed Apr 14 in the morning; Tom prefers shorter, focused sessions.

Of your options, Apr 14 10:00–10:45 PT looks promising. Can you lock that in? Also looping in Tom here for visibility.

A couple of asks from our side: please include a one‑slide summary of integration touchpoints and an updated MAP (we saw the PDF you sent). We'll bring our platform owner and our security lead as optional attendees.

—
Alicia Rivera
Senior Product Manager, Integrations | Novaforge
alicia.rivera@novaforge.com
+1 (650) 555‑2209

Subject: Re: Need to shift demo to CTO re-entry window — proposed times

Hi Alicia / Tom — great, thanks for the quick turn.

We can confirm Wed Apr 14, 10:00–10:45 PT. I'll send an updated calendar invite momentarily with a tightened agenda and timeboxed owners. Agenda highlights I'll include in the invite:
- 5 mins quick intros and goals (Alicia/Tom)
- 20 mins architecture walkthrough (Redwood infra + integration points)
- 10 mins security/data handling Qs (we'll have our security PM on)
- 10 mins next steps / MAP alignment

Marissa (cc'd) will add Redwood-Agenda-45min.docx to the invite. Ben, can you confirm the demo environment will show the integration flow and have the KV/cache example loaded?

Sending invite now.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

All — I'm back and cleared to join Apr 14 at 10:00 PT for 45 minutes. Appreciate you accommodating the travel timing.

Two quick notes from our side:
- Please include one slide on expected latency and cost profiles for our traffic patterns.
- I'll upload a short integration checklist from Novaforge ahead of the call (will share in email).

Looking forward — see you Wednesday.
